/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import ast
s='''def groups(mask):
    remaining = set((int(p[0]), int(p[1])) for p in np.argwhere(mask))
    result = []
    while remaining:
        p = next(iter(remaining))
        remaining.remove(p)
        todo = [p]
        cells = [p]
        while todo:
            r, c = todo.pop()
            for q in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if q in remaining:
                    remaining.remove(q)
                    todo.append(q)
                    cells.append(q)
        result.append(cells)
    return result
'''
t=ast.parse(s)
assert all(isinstance(x,ast.FunctionDef) for x in t.body)
assert not any(isinstance(x,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom,ast.With,ast.Try,ast.ClassDef,ast.Global)) for x in ast.walk(t))
assert not any(isinstance(x,ast.Attribute) and x.attr.startswith('_') for x in ast.walk(t))
print('Component helper passes source restrictions; planner uses the same restricted operations.')
PY"
